ValidationRule.description: Detail, Sample, and Brand Reminder rows require a parent product. Fires only on create or when Parent Product / Product Type changes, so legacy rows can still be edited.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Parent_Product__c), ISCHANGED(Product_Type__c) ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Product_Type__c, "Detail"), ISPICKVAL(Product_Type__c, "Sample"), ISPICKVAL(Product_Type__c, "Brand Reminder") ), ISBLANK(Parent_Product__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Select a parent product for this product type.
